items.exampleEn: Someone sneezed loudly during the movie.
items.exampleZh: 看電影時有人大聲打了個噴嚏。

items.exampleEn: My old dog is unfit and gets tired quickly.
items.exampleZh: 我的老狗體能不好，很容易累。

items.exampleEn: My grandmother's eyesight is getting weaker.
items.exampleZh: 我奶奶的視力越來越差。

items.exampleEn: Mr. Lin is unwell today, so the meeting has been moved.
items.exampleZh: 林先生今天身體不舒服，所以會議已經改期了。

items.exampleEn: Sitting on a bad chair gave me a backache.
items.exampleZh: 坐在不好的椅子上讓我背痛。

items.exampleEn: The little boy cried because he had an earache.
items.exampleZh: 小男孩因為耳朵痛而哭了。

items.exampleEn: My grandfather had a heart attack last year, but he is fine now.
items.exampleZh: 我爺爺去年心臟病發作，但現在沒事了。

items.exampleEn: Scientists have made great progress in HIV research.
items.exampleZh: 科學家在愛滋病毒研究上有很大的進展。

items.sentenceEn: She felt unwell and went home early.
items.sentenceZh: 她覺得身體不舒服，就提早回家了。

items.audioEn: I can't come to the meeting today; I have a terrible backache from lifting boxes.
items.audioZh: 我今天不能來開會，搬箱子讓我背痛得很厲害。
items.questionZh: 說話者為什麼不能來開會？

items.sentenceEn: Cats have good eyesight at night.
The hospital offers free HIV tests every Friday.
items.sentenceZh: 這家醫院每週五提供免費的 HIV 檢測。

items.stemEn: Loud music at the concert gave me ____.
items.stemZh: 演唱會的大聲音樂讓我耳朵痛。

items.stemEn: After he started running every morning, he no longer felt ____.
items.stemZh: 他開始每天早上跑步後，就不再覺得體能不佳了。

items.passageEn: Last week, our company held a free health check for all workers. Many people found out they were unfit, so the company started a walking club. A doctor tested everyone's eyesight, and some people needed new glasses. Mr. Lin, who often has a backache, learned how to sit correctly at his desk. The doctor also talked about how to notice the signs of a heart attack. Because of the check, I had to cancel my lunch plans, but it was worth it.
items.passageZh: 上星期，我們公司為所有員工辦了免費健康檢查。很多人發現自己體能不佳，所以公司成立了健走社。一位醫生幫大家檢查視力，有些人需要新眼鏡。常常背痛的林先生學會了在辦公桌前怎麼正確地坐。醫生也講解了如何察覺心臟病發作的徵兆。因為這次檢查，我只好取消午餐的約，但很值得。

questions.questionZh: 公司為什麼成立健走社？
options: 很多人發現自己體能不佳

referenceEn: I had such a bad backache last night that I couldn't sleep.
My backache kept me awake last night.
rubricZh: backache 表示「背痛」，例如 have a backache 等說法
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式）

items.promptZh: 這些灰塵讓我一直打噴嚏。
referenceEn: The dust makes me sneeze again and again.
The dust kept making me sneeze.
rubricZh: 用 sneeze 表示「打噴嚏」（例如 makes me sneeze）
「一直」可寫，例如 again and again、kept making me… 等；時態配合內容
